core_obligations: Choose an etale chart and transport the sheaf of differentials of the morphism to the chart using etale localisation compatibility.

Reduce local projectivity to the affine case.
Conclude via the affine cohomology computation.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a formally smooth morphism of algebraic spaces the sheaf of differentials is locally projective and that its first cohomology vanishes on affine pieces. The proof chooses an etale chart, transports the statement to the chart using the compatibility of differentials with etale localisation, and then invokes the affine computation of the relevant cohomology. Passing the local projectivity and the cohomology vanishing through the etale chart is what the argument turns on rather than any single local computation. Retained author proof at lines 4768-4773 with the surrounding argument.

This side is the more general statement (morphisms of algebraic spaces over S rather than of schemes) and it carries the genuine proof of 24 body lines, so under the count-the-more-general-side rule this side is the one counted. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes side assumes a formally smooth morphism of schemes; this side assumes a formally smooth morphism of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both conclude local projectivity of the sheaf of differentials.
